html:
Advanced Urology Care at Silver Touch Hospitals

Urinary issues can affect more than just your comfort; they can disrupt your daily life, sleep, and long-term health.

Are you suffering from such issues and seeking a male urology specialist in Ahmedabad? Look no further than Silver Touch Hospitals.

At Silver Touch Hospitals, our Urology department offers precise diagnosis and treatment for kidney, bladder, urethral, and prostate-related problems in both men and women.

With advanced surgical options, experienced consultants, and round-the-clock care, our team ensures that patients receive timely relief and long-term solutions.

Full-Service Urologist Hospital in Ahmedabad

Silver Touch Hospitals, being a reliable urologist hospital in Ahmedabad, provides end-to-end care across the gamut of urology. Our experts are well-versed in treating:

  • Kidney stones and ureteric stones
  • Enlarged prostate (BPH)
  • Urinary tract infections (UTIs)
  • Blood in urine (haematuria)
  • Male infertility and erectile dysfunction
  • Incontinence and voiding problems
  • Bladder tumours and urinary obstructions

By employing the latest diagnostics such as ultrasound, CT urography, uroflowmetry, and cystoscopy, we confirm that each condition is assessed with accuracy.

Personalised Urology Treatment in Ahmedabad

Silver Touch Hospitals offers a comprehensive range of urology treatment in Ahmedabad. Patients trust us because we provide evidence-based solutions, a seasoned team, and patient comfort. We listen to you carefully about your symptoms, lifestyle, and history before prescribing a personalised treatment plan.

Our consultants offer both simple and complicated urological problems, ranging from infections to surgical conditions, with compassion and transparency.

Minimally Invasive and Laparoscopic Urology Surgery in Ahmedabad

Our hospitals are equipped with the facilities to perform laparoscopic urology surgery in Ahmedabad for patients who need surgical treatment. These operations are carried out with minor cuts, resulting in minimal pain, quicker recovery, and fewer complications.

Some of the laparoscopic procedures are as follows:

  • Removal of kidney stones
  • Prostate surgery
  • Reconstruction of the ureters
  • Treatment of pelvic organ prolapse

Safe and Effective Laser Urology Treatment in Ahmedabad

For prostate disease or stone patients, laser urology treatment in Ahmedabad offers a bloodless, safer alternative to traditional surgery.

Silver Touch Hospitals applies high-power lasers for:

  • Holmium laser enucleation of the prostate (HoLEP)
  • Laser lithotripsy for ureteric and kidney stones
  • Bladder tumour ablation

They are all done by experienced surgeons with a high success rate and patient satisfaction.

Visit Our Reliable Urology Specialist in Ahmedabad

Do you need urology surgery in Ahmedabad or any other kind of urology treatment in Ahmedabad? Silver Touch Hospitals has you covered. Our professionals blend professionalism with confidentiality to help men’s health throughout life.

faqs.q: What are the typical signs I should visit a urologist?
faqs.a: Frequent urination, hematuria, trouble urinating, lower abdominal discomfort, or dysuria are symptoms to be assessed by a urologist.
The laser urology procedure is less painful than other surgeries. It heals faster, and most of the patients are released the same day or the following day.

faqs.q: Can you treat kidney stones without surgery?
faqs.a: Yes. Based on size and location, some stones can be addressed by medication or laser therapy without open surgery.

faqs.q: Is insurance coverage available for these treatments?
faqs.a: The majority of urology procedures and surgeries are health-insured. Our billing desk is happy to help with forms and questions.

faqs.q: Do you treat women's urology conditions as well?
faqs.a: Yes. We treat urinary incontinence, recurrent infections, and other female urology issues with complete discretion and sensitivity.
